items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: He was hustling over there, during the two years over there with Eisenhower and with the USO band.

ctx.x: He went overseas with ______ in the USO show. So they paid the guys a flat salary and they took

men like you never heard of, just guys that could play pretty good and they paid them a flat salary and then they were on (inaudible) and Battles came back and he come back -- when he got back, he had about $60,000. He was hustling over there, during the two years over there with Eisenhower and with the USO band. Then he went up there (inaudible) bought 180 acres of land. He sold it all off piece by piece, 30 acres at a time, like that. But he was throwing me money, he'd say, "Is that all?"
Yeah, do you want me to switch it off?
